propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui per stultitiam Crucis eminentem Jesu Christi scientiam beatum
Justinum Martyrem mirabiliter docuisti: ejus nobis intercessione concede;
ut, errorum circumventione depulsa, fidei firmitatem consequamur. Per eundem
Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.text:

sanctus Martyr Justinus adversum impiorum calumnias strenue defendit. Per

unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Caelesti alimonia refecti, supplices te, Domine, deprecamur: ut, beati
Justini Martyris tui monitis, de acceptis donis semper in gratiarum actione
maneamus. Per Dominum.
